summary.text: Dometic RUA5208X, RUA6408X and RUA8408X are absorption refrigerators that run on AC, 12 V DC or universal LPG, operated with a control knob and display. Faults appear on an error screen where the middle section turns red and shows a numbered code, with a beep for faults that stop cooling.

models.text: The operating manual covers the RUA5208X, RUA6408X and RUA8408X absorption refrigerators.
Total capacity: RUA5208X 146 l (13 l frozen), RUA6408X 180 l (46 l frozen), RUA8408X 216 l (46 l frozen); connection 230 to 240 V AC 50/60 Hz and 12 V DC; refrigerant R717.
RUA6408X and RUA8408X have a separate freezer compartment door, which the RUA5208X component list lacks, and only they show a freezer frame-heater symbol on the display.
Operate only at the gas pressure shown on the data plate, and use universal LPG only, not natural gas (see data plate).

display.text: A fault switches the display to the error screen: the middle section is highlighted in red and shows the error code, and the display does not go to standby.
Faults that stop the entire cooling function also beep; the beep lasts 2 minutes and repeats every 30 minutes until the fault is cleared.
If several faults occur, the display shows the last fault; after it has been cleared, the subsequent faults are displayed.
Codes 05, 06, 10 and 50-53 come with a flashing icon; 10 and 07-09 also beep.
On gas the refrigerator makes 3 ignition attempts 2 minutes apart, each stopped after 30 seconds without flame; if all 3 fail, an error code is displayed.
A tank stop symbol shows when the vehicle ignition is switched off; gas operation is disabled for 15 minutes.
The D+ symbol means the switching signal D+ is detected; automatic operation mode is only available when D+ is detected.
Battery save mode switches off outer fans, front frame heater and defrost, runs on gas only, and deactivates power-source selection.
After 3 minutes without use the display goes to standby; a snowflake in the upper left corner shows the refrigerator is still on.

reset.text: WARNING type faults (01, 05, 06, 10, 11, 14, 15, 17, 22, 24 and tank stop) reset automatically once the fault has been rectified.
ERROR type faults (03, 07-09, 12, 13, 16, 18, 50-53) must be reset manually: press and hold the control knob between 2 and 4 seconds.
Dometic support: press the encoder button for 3 seconds until you hear a beep; holding it too long turns the refrigerator off without resetting the error.
For 15 and 17 (low current at the frame or defrost heater), switch the refrigerator off and on again.
Tank stop mode: wait 15 minutes or switch to another type of supply.

checks.text: Park the vehicle level, especially when starting up and filling the refrigerator before setting off.
AC operation not working: replace a defective fuse in the AC power supply and connect the vehicle to AC power.
DC operation not working: replace the vehicle fuse in the DC socket (see vehicle manual), charge the vehicle battery, and switch on the ignition.
Gas operation not working: replace an empty gas cylinder, open the gas valve, and for air in the supply line switch the refrigerator off and on, several times if necessary.
Running on gas in automatic mode while on AC means the voltage is too low; it changes back to AC automatically when the voltage is sufficient.
Not cooling enough: check the ventilation grille, door closing and seals; defrost an iced evaporator; set a higher cooling capacity; remove food overload; check again after 4-5 hours.
Code 22 (DC below 10 V) switches to gas automatically: charge the vehicle battery. Code 24: ensure sufficient grounding of the display element.
Select DC only with the engine running and supplying sufficient voltage or with a battery monitor, and only after the set cooling temperature has been reached.
At altitudes above 1000 m, ignition problems may occur; switch to a different energy source.
Keep the exterior ventilation grilles and the refrigerator roof vent free of dust and dirt, and check and clean the condensate drain regularly.

parts.text: The fault table names the thermostat sensor, internal fan, frame heater, defrost heater, display-element grounding, power module, dynamic valve signal, gas valve and ignition electrode.
Fallback modes: with a thermostat sensor error (01) cooling cycles 45 minutes on and 15 off; with a defective internal fan (14) it uses a fixed setting, cut-in +1 °C, cut-out -13 °C.
AC heating element, DC heating element and the fuse in the DC cable: if defective, contact an authorized service agent.
An automatic safety device cuts off the gas supply to the burner about 30 seconds after the flame goes out.
The refrigerator compartment has a cyclic defrost system; long use in high humidity or high ambient temperature can still frost the evaporator fins and require manual defrosting.
Inspect the gas burner periodically so contamination or vermin do not impede burner performance.

callTech.text: Gas odor: close the gas supply tap and cylinder valve, open all windows and leave, operate no electrical switch, extinguish open flames, and have the gas system checked by a specialist.
Contact an authorized service agent for codes 01, 03 and 14, and whenever 07-09, 12, 13, 15-18, 24 or 51-53 occur again after a reset.
Work on gas and electrical installations may only be performed by qualified technicians; disconnect AC and DC power and turn off the gas before servicing.
Have the gas system and connected flues inspected regularly by a qualified specialist, and keep a record of any maintenance performed.
Never open or damage the refrigerant circuit.
